Title: Cyrena.Angular - CyrenaBuilderExtensions
Summary: Extension method on CyrenaBuilder that registers AngularBuilder (ICodeBuilder) and AngularShortcut (IShortcut) with the Cyrena framework.

## CyrenaBuilderExtensions

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.Extensions`
**Assembly:** `Cyrena.Angular`

### Purpose
Extension method on `CyrenaBuilder` to register all Angular development services with the Cyréna framework.

### Class Definition

```csharp
public static class CyrenaBuilderExtensions
{
    public static CyrenaBuilder AddAngular(this CyrenaBuilder builder);
}
```

### AddAngular Behavior
1. Registers `AngularBuilder` as singleton `ICodeBuilder`:
   ```csharp
   builder.Services.AddSingleton<ICodeBuilder, AngularBuilder>();
   ```
2. Registers `AngularShortcut` as an `IShortcut`:
   ```csharp
   builder.AddShortcut<AngularShortcut>();
   ```
3. Registers `ComponentFolderWatcher` as an `IStartupTask`:
   ```csharp
   builder.AddStartupTask<ComponentFolderWatcher>();
   ```

### Usage
Called by `AngularExtension.BuildExtension()`:
```csharp
public class AngularExtension : Extension
{
    public override void BuildExtension(CyrenaBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.AddAngular();
    }
}
```

### Related Types
- `AngularExtension` — Entry point that calls `AddAngular()`
- `AngularBuilder` — `ICodeBuilder` registered by this method
- `AngularShortcut` — `IShortcut` registered by this method
- `ComponentFolderWatcher` — `IStartupTask` registered by this method; cleans up empty component folders on file deletion
- `AngularOptions.BuilderId` — `"angular"`
